Definition: from the same as G2132; kindness; euphemistically, conjugal duty:--benevolence, good will.
BiblicalUsage: eúnoia is a plain word for benevolence, good will. In Ephesians 6:7, the text says "With good will doing service."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of eúnoia I do not force more than it gives: benevolence, good will.
